Proficiency
{
You may meet the ELP requirement if you meet ANY of the options listed below. You are required to submit documentation to prove your fluency.
CU Denver does not accept Letters of Instruction (LOIs) issued by schools as proof of English language proficiency. Applicants must provide official test scores or other approved documentation.
You must provide proof of English language proficiency (ELP) in order to be considered for full admission. Some graduate applicants will be considered for conditional admission if they apply without adequate

Document Retention Policy
All credentials submitted as application materials become the property of the University of Colorado Denver. We will NOT return any academic documents submitted to CU Denver as part of an application or after admission.
If you are unable to comply with this policy, or if this policy causes undue hardship, please contact International Admissions at [email protected] before submitting any documents to CU Denver.
International applicants may meet the English language proficiency requirement through any of the options below for previous coursework completed.
Options for Previous Coursework Completed to Satisfy Admissions ELP Requirement
Earn a post-secondary bachelor's degree or higher degree in the United States.
Earn 12 or more credit hours, with a GPA of 3.0 or higher, in a master's or doctoral degree program in the United States.
Earn one of the following credentials:
A post-secondary credential, comparable to a U.S. bachelor's degree or higher in one of the countries listed below.
OR
The equivalent of 12 or more credit hours in a master's or doctoral program with a GPA of 3.0 or higher in one of the countries listed below.
Antigua & Barbuda, Australia, The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Botswana, Brunei, Cameroon, Canada, Dominica, The Gambia, Ghana, Grenada, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Liberia, Malawi, Malta, Mauritius, Namibia, New Zealand, Nigeria,
Philippines, Saint Kitts & Nevis, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent & the Grenadines, Sierra Leone, Singapore, South Africa, Tanzania, Trinidad & Tobago, Uganda, United Kingdom, Zambia, Zimbabwe.
International applicants holding citizenship from the following countries do not need to prove their English language proficiency for admission to CU Denver:
Antigua & Barbuda, Australia, Barbados, Belize, Canada, Dominica, Granada, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Malta, New Zealand, Saint Kitts & Nevis, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent & the Grenadines, The Bahamas, Trinidad & Tobago, United Kingdom
Note: This list is based on the United Kingdom government’s list of countries exempt from proving English ability when applying for a UK student visa.

International Credential Evaluation Requirement
An International Credential Evaluation Report is required for any applicant who attended one or more academic institution(s) located outside the United States. All international credentials from academic institution(s) located outside the United States will need to be verified for authenticity and evaluated by CU Denver or an external evaluation provider (ECE or WES).
If you are applying for CU Denver programs, you have two options to choose from:
CU Denver In-House Evaluation
External Evaluation (ECE or WES course by course only)
If you are applying for CU Anschutz medical programs, you must provide an external evaluation report (ECE or WES course by course only).
Please carefully read through each of the options below.

Post-Secondary Transcripts
{
You are required to submit complete transcripts from ALL post-secondary/schools you have attended –
even if you did not graduate from the school.
Indian applicants: Please be sure to submit all mark sheets and a degree/provisional certificate issued by the university, not an affiliated institution or college.
Read everything under "Important Information" below
Notice: International Admissions reserves the right to deny an application or rescind an application decision where the applicant fails to disclose educational work performed. Reasonable attempts to obtain missing academic records must be documented and verified for a conditional admission decision to proceed. View our frequently asked questions or contact us for more information. We are here to help!
Important Information
Transcript Translation
If your transcript was issued in a language other than English, you must also provide a certified English translation of the transcript.
CU Denver does not have a preferred translation provider; we recommend that you use an ATA member company.
International Admissions will evaluate your transcript during the application process. You only need to provide a translation. You will need to provide both the original language transcript and a translation if they are not issued in English.
How to Submit Documents for In-House International Credential Evaluations
Electronically:
Electronic submission is the preferred method of document submission.
Documents can be submitted through the following methods:
Upload directly to application portal while completing online application (preferred method for unofficial documents)
Electronic delivery services such as Parchment, Naviance, eScrip-Safe or SPEEDE/National Student Clearing House (preferred method for official US transcripts)
Email - International Admissions has a special inbox for application documentation: [email protected]
Please do not submit unnecessary documents to [email protected]. These will slow application processing.
All prospect, applicant, and admitted student inquiries should otherwise be directed to the [email protected] email address.

Unofficial and Official Transcripts for In-House International Credential Evaluations
Unofficial or Official transcripts can be submitted for admission consideration. However, your school/college requires an official transcript at the time of application. We encourage you to submit an official transcript at the time of application.
If the school you attended is located INSIDE THE UNITED STATES:
You are required to submit an OFFICIAL transcript.
If the school you attended is located OUTSIDE THE UNITED STATES:
If you have an OFFICIAL transcript available, you are required to submit it.
If you only have an UNOFFICIAL transcript, you are required to submit it.
Document Retention Policy
All credentials submitted as application materials become the property of the University of Colorado Denver. We will NOT return any academic documents submitted to CU Denver as part of an application or after admission.
If you are unable to comply with this policy, or if this policy causes undue hardship, please contact International Admissions at [email protected] before submitting any documents to CU Denver.
*Please note that these evaluations are the property of CU Denver and will be for internal use only.
ECE or WES must authenticate and submit a credential report directly to CU Denver/Anschutz Medical Campus. Please note that a course-by-course evaluation from ECE or WES is required as part of the application and admission review process for Anschutz Medical Campus programs. To ensure timely processing of your application, please submit the evaluation report prior to the application deadline.
Do not submit transcripts from foreign (non-US) institutions to CU Denver. Instead, you must provide an international credential evaluation report from Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE) or World Education Services (WES). You will send your transcripts to the evaluation provider of your choice, and the provider will send their evaluation report to CU Denver.
After you submit your application, we will send you an email with a link to the specific landing pages where you can order your report for CU Denver’s use.
ECE or WES will charge you for this service. The cost is $163 to $208, depending on your chosen service, plus delivery fees. If you have questions about the international credential evaluation, please contact International Admissions at [email protected].
